For real-valued \(x^x\), we take \(x>0\). Taking logs:

\[
x^x = 10 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad x\ln x = \ln 10.
\]

This has a unique real solution. Numerically,

\[
x \approx 2.50618414558877.
\]

Check:

\[
(2.50618414558877)^{2.50618414558877} \approx 10.
\]

So the solution is

\[
\boxed{x \approx 2.50618414558877}
\]
